title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face for $12.93B in 2026
summary: NVIDIA reportedly plans to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, merging AI hardware leadership with the world's largest open-source model platform.
body_markdown:
**OFFICIAL RELEASE — Sep 11, 2026:** Nvidia Acquires Hugging Face for $13 Billion in 2026


#### 💡 TL;DR


- Nvidia officially completed its $13 billion acquisition of Hugging Face on September 3, 2026, gaining control of the world's largest open AI model repository.
- The chipmaker pledged to maintain Hugging Face's open-source model and preserve its community-driven ecosystem despite the ownership change.
- The acquisition gives Nvidia strategic control over a platform hosting over 500,000 AI models and 100,000 datasets used by millions of developers.


Nvidia has closed its acquisition of Hugging Face for $13 billion, bringing the world's most popular AI model repository under the chipmaker's control. Officially launched on September 3, 2026, the deal marks one of the largest AI infrastructure acquisitions in history and positions Nvidia at the center of the open-source AI ecosystem. The company has committed to maintaining Hugging Face's open-access model despite the ownership change.


## Strategic Rationale Behind the Acquisition


The acquisition gives Nvidia direct oversight of a platform that has become essential infrastructure for AI development. Hugging Face hosts over 500,000 pre-trained models, 100,000 datasets, and serves millions of developers globally. By controlling this distribution channel, Nvidia gains unprecedented visibility into AI model development trends and usage patterns across the industry.


Analysts note the deal complements Nvidia's dominance in AI compute hardware. While the company already powers most large-scale AI training through its GPU offerings, owning the primary model-sharing platform creates a vertical integration play spanning hardware, software, and distribution. The $13 billion price tag represents roughly 15 times Hugging Face's estimated annual revenue, reflecting the strategic premium Nvidia placed on controlling this chokepoint in the AI development pipeline.


## Commitment to Open Access


Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang addressed developer concerns in a statement accompanying the announcement, pledging that Hugging Face would continue operating as an open platform. The company committed to maintaining free access to public model repositories, preserving the existing community governance structure, and keeping the platform vendor-neutral for competing AI frameworks.

However, some developers have expressed skepticism about these promises, noting that[previous security incidents involving Hugging Face](https://emergent.sh/news/openai-hugging-face-security-incident) demonstrate the platform's critical role in AI supply chain security. Critics worry that Nvidia's ownership could introduce subtle pressures favoring its own hardware or software stack over time.


## Impact on the AI Development Ecosystem


The acquisition reshapes competitive dynamics in AI infrastructure. Hugging Face had emerged as a neutral ground where researchers from Google, Meta, Anthropic, and other labs could share work outside their corporate walls. With Nvidia now controlling this space, questions arise about whether rival chipmakers like AMD or Intel will continue treating the platform as neutral territory.


The deal also affects partnerships across the industry.[GitHub integration](https://emergent.sh/integrations/github) with Hugging Face models, cloud partnerships with AWS and Google Cloud, and enterprise licensing arrangements will all continue under Nvidia's oversight. The company has signaled no immediate changes to these relationships, but longer-term strategic shifts remain possible as integration plans develop.


## Financial and Market Context


At $13 billion, the acquisition represents Nvidia's largest deal to date and comes amid the company's market capitalization hovering near $3 trillion. The chipmaker financed the purchase through a combination of cash reserves and stock, avoiding the need for significant debt financing. Hugging Face's existing investors, including Salesforce Ventures, Google, and Amazon, realized substantial returns on their holdings.


The deal closed faster than typical acquisitions of this scale, with regulatory approval secured in under six months. Antitrust authorities in the US and EU approved the transaction after Nvidia agreed to legally binding commitments around platform openness and non-discrimination. These commitments include regular audits by independent third parties and penalties for violations.


## What This Means


Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face consolidates the company's position across the entire AI stack, from silicon to model distribution. While the chipmaker's commitments to openness provide some reassurance, the deal concentrates significant power in a single entity that already dominates AI compute. The true test will come in how Nvidia balances its commercial interests with the preservation of the collaborative, open-source culture that made Hugging Face valuable in the first place. Developers and organizations dependent on the platform will be watching closely for any signs that neutrality is compromised in favor of Nvidia's strategic priorities.


#### 💡 TL;DR


- NVIDIA is rumored to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, combining GPU infrastructure with open-source AI distribution.
- The deal would give NVIDIA direct control over the platform hosting 1 million models and 10 million monthly users.
- Industry analysts view this as NVIDIA's strategic move to vertically integrate from hardware through deployment infrastructure.


[NVIDIA](https://emergent.sh/news/nvidia-ai-lab-financing-powers-25-2025) is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire[Hugging Face](https://emergent.sh/news/openai-addresses-hugging-face-security) , the world's largest open-source AI model repository, for $12.93 billion. The deal would mark one of the most significant consolidations in AI infrastructure, bringing together the dominant GPU manufacturer with the platform that hosts over 1 million machine learning models and serves 10 million monthly users.


## Strategic Rationale Behind the Acquisition


The acquisition positions NVIDIA to control the full AI stack, from silicon through deployment. Hugging Face has become the de facto distribution platform for open-source models including Llama, Mistral, and thousands of community-trained variants. By owning this infrastructure, NVIDIA would gain unprecedented visibility into model development trends and direct relationships with enterprises deploying AI at scale.


Industry analysts note the deal represents a vertical integration play similar to cloud providers building their own chips. NVIDIA already provides the hardware powering most AI training and inference. Adding Hugging Face would give the company direct control over model discovery, versioning, and deployment workflows that currently sit outside its ecosystem.


## Expected Release Timeline


Sources familiar with the negotiations indicate the deal is expected to release on an unspecified 2026 timeline, pending regulatory approval in multiple jurisdictions. Antitrust scrutiny is anticipated given NVIDIA's existing dominance in AI compute. The Federal Trade Commission and European Commission are both likely to review whether combining hardware and platform layers creates anti-competitive barriers.


## Impact on Open Source Ecosystem


The acquisition raises questions about Hugging Face's commitment to open collaboration. The platform currently operates as a neutral hub where researchers from Meta, Google, Anthropic, and independent labs share work freely. NVIDIA ownership could shift incentives toward models optimized for its hardware, potentially fragmenting the ecosystem.


- Hugging Face hosts 1.2 million repositories including models, datasets, and applications
- The platform supports PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, and other frameworks without hardware bias
- Over 50,000 organizations use Hugging Face for production AI deployments
- The company's Transformers library has 180,000 GitHub stars and powers billions of daily inferences


CEO Clement Delangue has previously emphasized platform neutrality as core to Hugging Face's mission. How that philosophy survives under NVIDIA ownership remains unclear. Some community members are already discussing alternative hosting platforms to maintain independence from hardware vendors.


## Financial and Competitive Context


The $12.93 billion valuation represents approximately 25x Hugging Face's estimated annual recurring revenue of $500 million. That premium reflects both the platform's strategic importance and NVIDIA's substantial cash reserves from GPU sales to hyperscalers. The deal would be NVIDIA's largest acquisition since the failed $40 billion Arm purchase collapsed under regulatory pressure in 2022.


Competitors including AMD, Intel, and AWS are likely monitoring the situation closely. If approved, the acquisition could accelerate their own efforts to build alternative model distribution channels. AWS already operates SageMaker JumpStart, while Google maintains Model Garden. An NVIDIA-controlled Hugging Face might push more vendors toward proprietary platforms.


## What This Means


This rumored acquisition signals a fundamental shift in AI infrastructure consolidation. If completed, NVIDIA would control critical layers from chip design through model deployment, creating the industry's first true end-to-end AI stack. The move could accelerate innovation by tightly coupling hardware and software optimization, but it also concentrates power in ways that may reshape competitive dynamics across the sector. For developers and enterprises, the key question is whether open collaboration survives or fragments under new ownership.
